name: BTCUSDT 5m futures strategy
summary: Tune a leveraged long/short trading strategy with a realistic walk-forward backtest. The executor edits strategy.py (signals() + PARAMS); a committed harness scores return, liquidations and drawdown on a held-out out-of-sample tail (anti-overfit). The engine is symbol-agnostic — it ships with BTCUSDT 5m demo data, and you swap harness/data.csv (time,open,high,low,close,volume) for any instrument or timeframe.

executor.task: Edit strategy.py — tune PARAMS and/or rewrite the signals() logic (add indicators, change entry/exit rules, restructure). Do NOT modify or run anything under ../metrics/ (the scoring harness). One focused change per step.

validator.goal: Review the strategy and the change: your honest opinion on whether the approach is soundly built, why the score moved, and one or two concrete ideas (PARAMS or signals logic) to try next.
